blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The civil society group August Twenty-One Movement (Atom) slammed the alleged “special treatment” given to former House Speaker Martin Romualdez at the New Quezon City Jail, questioning why he was reportedly allowed to have an assistant stay with him inside his detention cell. “In other countries, these types of incidents are not tolerated; immediate consequences would follow within 24 to 48 hours,” Atom said in a statement on Monday. “If actions like this are applied to powerful people like the former speaker, then ordinary citizens should also enjoy the benefit of an assistant inside jail just like Speaker […]...
